title: 元知识详解：信息理论 — Day 10

questions.question: 设 X 在 −1 到 1 之间均匀取值，Y = X²。下面哪个判断正确？
options: 两者相关系数接近 1，因为 Y 总是随着 X 的增大而增大
两者互信息为 0，因为它们的关系不是一条直线
两者相关系数为 0，但 Y 完全由 X 决定，互信息很高
两者相关系数为 0，所以可以认为两者相互独立
questions.explanation: 相关系数只看是否同涨同跌，对称的抛物线让它严格为 0；但知道 X 就完全知道 Y，互信息很高。「零相关等于独立」正是文中说不少风险模型栽进去的坑。
questions.question_en: Let X be uniform on −1 to 1 and Y = X². Which statement is correct?
options_en: Their correlation is near 1, because Y increases as X increases
Their mutual information is 0, because the relationship isn't a straight line
Their correlation is 0, yet Y is fully determined by X, so mutual information is high
Their correlation is 0, so the two can be treated as independent
questions.explanation_en: Correlation only captures moving together linearly, and the symmetric parabola makes it exactly 0; but knowing X tells you Y completely, so mutual information is high. 'Zero correlation means independence' is the trap the article says many risk models fell into.

questions.question: 按信道容量的规律，为什么 5G 主要去抢更宽的频谱，而不是单纯加大发射功率？
options: 加大功率会让噪声也同比例放大，信噪比根本不会改变
频谱越宽，需要的纠错编码越少，速度自然更快
容量随带宽成倍增长，信噪比翻倍却只让容量增加一点
只要功率足够大，就能让出错率直接降到零
questions.explanation: 容量公式里带宽翻倍容量翻倍，信噪比翻倍容量只增加一点点，所以抢频谱比堆功率划算。容量定理说的是速率不超过容量时存在让错误率趋近于 0 的编码，靠的是编码而不是功率。
questions.question_en: By the laws of channel capacity, why does 5G mainly go after wider spectrum rather than simply boosting transmit power?
options_en: More power amplifies noise equally, so the signal-to-noise ratio never changes
Wider spectrum needs less error-correcting code, so it's naturally faster
Capacity doubles with bandwidth, but doubling signal-to-noise adds only a little
With enough power, the error rate can be driven straight down to zero
questions.explanation_en: In the capacity formula, doubling bandwidth doubles capacity while doubling signal-to-noise adds only a little, so spectrum beats power. The theorem promises codes with vanishing error below capacity — the work is done by coding, not by power.

questions.question: 圆周率 π 的前一万亿位看上去像一串乱码。按柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度，它的信息量如何？
options: 极低，因为一个很短的程序就能生成它
等于一万亿位乘以每一位所需的比特数
极高，因为数字序列看不出任何规律
无法定义，因为 π 是无限不循环的无理数
questions.explanation: 柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度把信息量定义为能生成它的最短程序的长度；π 能用几百字符的小程序算出，所以复杂度极低。「看起来随机」不等于「真的随机」，这正是这个概念的要点。
questions.question_en: The first trillion digits of π look like noise. By Kolmogorov complexity, how much information do they contain?
options_en: Very little, because a short program can generate them
A trillion times the bits needed for each single digit
A great deal, because the digits show no visible pattern
It's undefined, because π is an irrational number
questions.explanation_en: Kolmogorov complexity measures information as the length of the shortest program that produces the object; π can be computed by a program of a few hundred characters, so its complexity is very low. Looking random is not being random — that's the point of the concept.
